meanings.en: the act or result of measuring something
meanings.exampleEn: The tailor took my measurements before making the suit.
meanings.exampleTr: Terzi takım elbiseyi yapmadan önce ölçülerimi aldı.

meanings.en: a person who repairs machines, especially vehicles
meanings.exampleEn: The mechanic fixed my car's engine in an hour.
meanings.exampleTr: Tamirci arabamın motorunu bir saatte tamir etti.

meanings.en: relating to or operated by machines
meanings.exampleEn: The factory uses mechanical arms to assemble the products.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika ürünleri monte etmek için mekanik kollar kullanıyor.

meanings.en: to think deeply or focus the mind for relaxation
meanings.exampleEn: She likes to meditate for ten minutes every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Her sabah on dakika meditasyon yapmayı seviyor.

meanings.en: the practice of focusing the mind for calm or spiritual purposes
meanings.exampleEn: Meditation helps me reduce stress after work.
meanings.exampleTr: Meditasyon işten sonra stresimi azaltmama yardımcı oluyor.

meanings.en: the sea between Europe, Africa and Asia, or its region
meanings.exampleEn: We spent our holiday sailing across the Mediterranean.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatilimizi Akdeniz'de yelken açarak geçirdik.

meanings.en: of middle size, amount, or degree
meanings.exampleEn: I would like a medium coffee, please.
meanings.exampleTr: Orta boy bir kahve istiyorum, lütfen.

meanings.en: to change from solid to liquid by heat
meanings.exampleEn: The ice cream began to melt in the hot sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Dondurma sıcak güneşte erimeye başladı.

meanings.en: the state of being a member of a group or organization
meanings.exampleEn: My gym membership expires at the end of the month.
meanings.exampleTr: Spor salonu üyeliğim ay sonunda sona eriyor.

meanings.en: worth remembering or easy to remember
meanings.exampleEn: Our trip to Italy was a truly memorable experience.
meanings.exampleTr: İtalya'ya yaptığımız gezi gerçekten unutulmaz bir deneyimdi.

meanings.en: to learn something so that you remember it exactly
meanings.exampleEn: The students had to memorize the poem for class.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler ders için şiiri ezberlemek zorundaydı.

meanings.en: to repair something that is broken or torn
meanings.exampleEn: My grandmother taught me how to mend a torn shirt.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannem bana yırtık bir gömleği nasıl onaracağımı öğretti.

meanings.en: relating to the mind or the process of thinking
meanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise improves both physical and mental health.
meanings.exampleTr: Düzenli egzersiz hem fiziksel hem de zihinsel sağlığı iyileştirir.

meanings.en: in a way relating to the mind
meanings.exampleEn: She prepared herself mentally for the difficult interview.
meanings.exampleTr: Zorlu mülakata kendini zihinsel olarak hazırladı.

meanings.en: a person who buys and sells goods, especially in large amounts
meanings.exampleEn: The wealthy merchant traded silk and spices across the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Zengin tüccar deniz aşırı ipek ve baharat ticareti yapıyordu.

meanings.en: used to emphasize that something is small or unimportant
meanings.exampleEn: The mere thought of the exam made him nervous.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınavın sadece düşüncesi bile onu gergin yaptı.

meanings.en: used to say that something is only what is stated and nothing more
meanings.exampleEn: I was merely trying to help you with your work.
meanings.exampleTr: Sadece işinde sana yardım etmeye çalışıyordum.

meanings.en: a dirty or untidy state of things
meanings.exampleEn: Please clean up the mess in your room.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen odandaki dağınıklığı temizle.

meanings.en: a website area where people post and read messages
meanings.exampleEn: He asked his question on the online message board.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorusunu çevrimiçi mesaj panosunda sordu.

meanings.en: dirty or untidy
meanings.exampleEn: His desk was so messy that he couldn't find his keys.
meanings.exampleTr: Masası o kadar dağınıktı ki anahtarlarını bulamadı.

meanings.en: between about 45 and 65 years old
meanings.exampleEn: A middle-aged man sat reading a newspaper in the park.
meanings.exampleTr: Orta yaşlı bir adam parkta gazete okuyarak oturuyordu.

meanings.en: not strong, severe, or extreme
meanings.exampleEn: The winter was unusually mild this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yıl kış alışılmadık şekilde ılımandı.

meanings.en: a unit of distance equal to about 1.6 kilometres
meanings.exampleEn: We walked five miles along the coast yesterday.
meanings.exampleTr: Dün sahil boyunca beş mil yürüdük.

meanings.en: a natural substance found in the earth, such as iron or salt
meanings.exampleEn: This water is rich in minerals like calcium.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu su kalsiyum gibi minerallerce zengindir.

meanings.en: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount
meanings.exampleEn: We must minimize the risk of accidents at work.
meanings.exampleTr: İş yerinde kaza riskini en aza indirmeliyiz.

meanings.en: the smallest amount or level that is allowed or possible
meanings.exampleEn: The minimum age to drive in this country is eighteen.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ülkede araç kullanmak için asgari yaş on sekizdir.

meanings.en: not very important or serious
meanings.exampleEn: It was only a minor problem that we fixed quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, hızlıca çözdüğümüz küçük bir sorundan ibaretti.

meanings.en: a smaller number or part within a larger group
meanings.exampleEn: Only a small minority of students failed the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrencilerin yalnızca küçük bir azınlığı sınavda başarısız oldu.

meanings.en: a surprising and very welcome event that seems impossible
meanings.exampleEn: It was a miracle that everyone survived the crash.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin kazadan sağ kurtulması bir mucizeydi.

meanings.en: behaviour that causes trouble but is not seriously bad
meanings.exampleEn: The children were always getting into mischief.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar her zaman yaramazlık yapıyorlardı.

meanings.en: very unhappy or uncomfortable
meanings.exampleEn: He felt miserable after losing his job.
meanings.exampleTr: İşini kaybettikten sonra kendini perişan hissetti.

meanings.en: great unhappiness or suffering
meanings.exampleEn: The war brought misery to thousands of families.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş binlerce aileye sefalet getirdi.

meanings.en: an important task or duty given to a person or group
meanings.exampleEn: The astronauts completed their mission to the space station.
meanings.exampleTr: Astronotlar uzay istasyonuna olan görevlerini tamamladılar.

meanings.en: covered with or full of mist
meanings.exampleEn: The mountains looked beautiful on the misty morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlar sisli sabahta çok güzel görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a large bowl used for mixing ingredients when cooking
meanings.exampleEn: She cracked the eggs into a large mixing bowl.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumurtaları büyük bir karıştırma kasesine kırdı.

meanings.en: a verb such as 'can' or 'must' used with another verb to express possibility or necessity
meanings.exampleEn: The word 'should' is a common modal verb in English.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Should' kelimesi İngilizcede yaygın bir kip fiilidir.

meanings.en: considered to be an excellent example to copy
meanings.exampleEn: She was a model student, always polite and hardworking.
meanings.exampleTr: O, her zaman kibar ve çalışkan, örnek bir öğrenciydi.

meanings.en: a device that connects a computer to the internet through a network
meanings.exampleEn: I had to restart the modem to fix the internet connection.
meanings.exampleTr: İnternet bağlantısını düzeltmek için modemi yeniden başlatmak zorunda kaldım.

meanings.en: to change something slightly, usually to improve it
meanings.exampleEn: We had to modify the plan to fit the new budget.
meanings.exampleTr: Planı yeni bütçeye uydurmak için değiştirmek zorunda kaldık.

meanings.en: very small drops of water in the air or on a surface
meanings.exampleEn: The moisture in the air made the windows foggy.
meanings.exampleTr: Havadaki nem camları buğulandırdı.

meanings.en: the smallest unit of a substance that has its chemical properties
meanings.exampleEn: A water molecule is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir su molekülü iki hidrojen ve bir oksijen atomundan oluşur.

meanings.en: a screen that shows information from a computer
meanings.exampleEn: He bought a larger monitor for his new computer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni bilgisayarı için daha büyük bir monitör aldı.

meanings.en: a member of a religious community of men living apart from society
meanings.exampleEn: The monk spent his days praying in the monastery.
meanings.exampleTr: Keşiş günlerini manastırda dua ederek geçiriyordu.

meanings.en: an imaginary frightening creature
meanings.exampleEn: The child was afraid of the monster under his bed.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk yatağının altındaki canavardan korkuyordu.

meanings.en: happening or done once a month
meanings.exampleEn: She pays a monthly fee for her phone service.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefon hizmeti için aylık bir ücret ödüyor.

meanings.en: a structure built to remember a person or event
meanings.exampleEn: They built a monument to honour the fallen soldiers.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehit askerleri onurlandırmak için bir anıt inşa ettiler.

meanings.en: to a greater degree or extent
meanings.exampleEn: You should rest more if you want to feel better.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha iyi hissetmek istiyorsan daha çok dinlenmelisin.

meanings.en: used to add information that supports a previous statement
meanings.exampleEn: The house is too small; moreover, it is far from the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev çok küçük; ayrıca şehre de uzak.

meanings.en: a small flying insect that bites and sucks blood
meanings.exampleEn: A mosquito bit me on the arm last night.
meanings.exampleTr: Dün gece bir sivrisinek beni kolumdan ısırdı.

meanings.en: a small green plant that grows on wet ground or stones
meanings.exampleEn: Green moss covered the old stone wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeşil yosun eski taş duvarı kaplamıştı.

meanings.en: the country where a person was born or feels they belong
meanings.exampleEn: After years abroad, he longed to return to his motherland.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca yurt dışında kaldıktan sonra anavatanına dönmeyi özledi.

meanings.en: not moving at all
meanings.exampleEn: The cat sat motionless, watching the bird.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi kuşu izleyerek hareketsiz oturdu.

meanings.en: to make someone want to do something
meanings.exampleEn: A good teacher can motivate students to learn.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi bir öğretmen öğrencileri öğrenmeye motive edebilir.

meanings.en: the reason or desire that makes someone act
meanings.exampleEn: Her main motivation for studying hard was to help her family.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıkı çalışmasının asıl motivasyonu ailesine yardım etmekti.

meanings.en: a reason for doing something
meanings.exampleEn: The police could not find a motive for the crime.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis suçun nedenini bulamadı.

meanings.en: a machine that produces movement or power for a vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: The boat's motor stopped working in the middle of the lake.
meanings.exampleTr: Teknenin motoru gölün ortasında çalışmayı durdurdu.

meanings.en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
meanings.exampleEn: He rides his motorcycle to work every day.
meanings.exampleTr: Her gün işe motosikletiyle gidiyor.

meanings.en: a short phrase expressing a belief or rule of behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: Their school motto is 'Always do your best'.
meanings.exampleTr: Okullarının sloganı 'Her zaman elinden gelenin en iyisini yap'.

meanings.en: a mountain, used before a name
meanings.exampleEn: Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world.
meanings.exampleTr: Everest Dağı dünyanın en yüksek zirvesidir.

meanings.en: the highest part of a mountain
meanings.exampleEn: From the mountaintop we could see the whole valley.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağ zirvesinden bütün vadiyi görebiliyorduk.

meanings.en: to feel or show deep sadness, especially after someone dies
meanings.exampleEn: The whole town mourned the death of the old doctor.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün kasaba yaşlı doktorun ölümünün ardından yas tuttu.

meanings.en: an act of changing position or place
meanings.exampleEn: The dancer's movements were smooth and graceful.
meanings.exampleTr: Dansçının hareketleri akıcı ve zarifti.

meanings.en: soft wet earth
meanings.exampleEn: The children played in the mud after the rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar yağmurdan sonra çamurda oynadılar.

meanings.en: an animal that is the offspring of a horse and a donkey
meanings.exampleEn: The farmer used a mule to carry heavy loads up the hill.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçi ağır yükleri tepeye taşımak için bir katır kullandı.

meanings.exampleEn: The police finally caught the murderer after months of searching.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis aylarca süren aramanın ardından katili sonunda yakaladı.

meanings.en: a body tissue that produces movement
meanings.exampleEn: Lifting weights helps you build muscle.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağırlık kaldırmak kas geliştirmene yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: a yellow spicy sauce eaten with food
meanings.exampleEn: He put some mustard on his hot dog.
meanings.exampleTr: Sosisli sandviçine biraz hardal sürdü.

meanings.en: felt or done by two or more people toward each other
meanings.exampleEn: Their friendship was based on mutual respect.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşlıkları karşılıklı saygıya dayanıyordu.

meanings.en: an old traditional story, often about gods or heroes
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient Greek myth tells the story of a brave hero.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik Yunan efsanesi cesur bir kahramanın hikayesini anlatır.

meanings.en: a thin metal pin used to join things, or the hard part at the end of a finger
meanings.exampleEn: He hammered a nail into the wall to hang the picture.
meanings.exampleTr: Resmi asmak için duvara bir çivi çaktı.
